legend: There are n2$$$n^2$$$ points on the coordinate plane, at the locations (1,1),(1,2),⋯(1,n),(2,1),(2,2),⋯(2,n),⋮⋮⋱⋮(n,1),(n,2),⋯(n,n).$$ \begin{matrix} (1,1), & (1,2), & \cdots & (1,n), \\ (2,1), & (2,2), & \cdots & (2,n), \\ \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ (n,1), & (n,2), & \cdots & (n,n). \\ \end{matrix} $$ More formally, the initial set of points S={(i,j)∣1≤i,j≤n}$$$S = \{(i,j) \mid 1 \leq i, j \leq n\}$$$.
You want to move each point to a different point such that
the distance each point moves is at least √d$$$\sqrt{d}$$$, and

the set of resulting points equals the set of initial points. That is, after all the points have moved, they occupy the same locations as before. (More formally, the final set of points equals S$$$S$$$.)
Given n$$$n$$$ and d$$$d$$$, find any such movement or report that it does not exist.
input: The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤150$$$1 \leq t \leq 150$$$) — the number of test cases.

The only line of each test case contains two space-separated integers n$$$n$$$ and d$$$d$$$ (2≤n≤300$$$2 \leq n \leq 300$$$, 1≤d≤109$$$1 \leq d \leq 10^9$$$) — the range of points and the square of the minimum distance each point must move, respectively.
The sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 300$$$300$$$.
output: For each test case, if such a movement is impossible, output NO.

Otherwise, output YES followed by n2$$$n^2$$$ lines. Each line should contain four space separated integers xi$$$x_i$$$, yi$$$y_i$$$, x′i$$$x'_i$$$, y′i$$$y'_i$$$ (1≤xi,yi,x′i,y′i≤n$$$1 \leq x_i, y_i, x'_i, y'_i \leq n$$$), representing that the point (xi,yi)$$$(x_i, y_i)$$$ moves to the point (x′i,y′i)$$$(x'_i, y'_i)$$$. The resulting points should satisfy the conditions in the problem statement.
If there are multiple possible movements, print any of them.
note: The picture below shows the movement for the first test case. Each point moves at least √1$$$\sqrt{1}$$$ units, and the set of resulting points is the set of initial points.

legend.ai: 你希望将每个点移动到一个不同的点，使得
每个点移动的距离至少为 √d$$$\sqrt{d}$$$，并且
移动后得到的点集与初始点集相同。也就是说，所有点移动完毕后，它们占据的位置与之前相同。(更正式地说，最终点集等于 S$$$S$$$。)
给定 n$$$n$$$ 和 d$$$d$$$，请找出任意一种这样的移动方案，或报告不存在。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤150$$$1 \leq t \leq 150$$$)——测试用例数。
每个测试用例仅有一行，包含两个以空格分隔的整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 d$$$d$$$(2≤n≤300$$$2 \leq n \leq 300$$$，1≤d≤109$$$1 \leq d \leq 10^9$$$)——点的范围，以及每个点必须移动的最小距离的平方。
所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 300$$$300$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果无法进行这样的移动，输出 NO。

否则，输出 YES，随后输出 n2$$$n^2$$$ 行。每行应包含四个由空格分隔的整数 xi$$$x_i$$$、yi$$$y_i$$$、x′i$$$x'_i$$$、y′i$$$y'_i$$$(1≤xi,yi,x′i,y′i≤n$$$1 \leq x_i, y_i, x'_i, y'_i \leq n$$$)，表示点 (xi,yi)$$$(x_i, y_i)$$$ 移动到点 (x′i,y′i)$$$(x'_i, y'_i)$$$。移动后的点应满足题目陈述中的条件。
如果存在多种可能的移动方案，输出任意一种即可。
